title: TRICARE Select Inpatient Stay Cost-Share Bases and Charges
content:
Inpatient facility stays under **TRICARE Select** are cost-shared by the stay, under a basis and amounts fixed per tier and per network relationship of the facility. The bases are: **per diem with minimum** (a daily charge times the inpatient days, never less than a minimum charge for the admission), **lesser of per diem or percent** (the lesser of the daily charge times the inpatient days and a stated percent of the facility allowed amount), **per admission copayment** (one copayment per stay) and **percent of allowed** (a stated percent of the allowed amount).

## Tier table (US dollars, percentages of the facility allowed amount)

The first four columns are the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers (for example, "Group A (E-1 to E-4)" is TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4)); the last two are TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.

| | Group A (E-1 to E-4) | Group A (E-5 and Above) | Group B (E-1 to E-4) | Group B (E-5 and Above) | Retiree Group A | Retiree Group B |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network basis | per diem with minimum | per diem with minimum | per admission copayment | per admission copayment | lesser of per diem or percent | per admission copayment |
| Network daily charge | 21.15 | 21.15 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 |
| Network minimum charge per admission | 25.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Network admission copayment | 0.00 | 0.00 | 76.00 | 76.00 | 0.00 | 201.00 |
| Network percent used in the lesser-of comparison | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 20 | 0 |
| Non-network basis | per diem with minimum | per diem with minimum | percent of allowed | percent of allowed | lesser of per diem or percent | percent of allowed |
| Non-network daily charge | 21.15 | 21.15 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1191.00 | 0.00 |
| Non-network percent | 0 | 0 | 20 | 20 | 25 | 25 |
| Outpatient deductible also applies to inpatient facility charges | no | no | no | no | no | no |

## Notes on the table

- A figure of 0.00 or 0 marks an amount the tier's basis does not use.
- No tier applies the outpatient deductible to an inpatient facility stay.

## Hypothetical stays

| Tier and facility | Stay | Liability under the basis |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above), network | 1 day | 21.15 for the day is less than the minimum, so 25.00 |
| Same tier, network | 4 days | 21.15 times 4: 84.60 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, network, allowed amount 6000.00 | 3 days | the lesser of 750.00 (250.00 times 3) and 1200.00 (20 percent): 750.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, network | any length | 201.00 once |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4), non-network, allowed amount 3000.00 | any length | 20 percent: 600.00 |
